structure.unit: Damage to and Tampering With Property

law.catch_line: Opening or carrying away pumps, etc., used for dispensing gasoline, etc
law.text: If any person, with intent to commit larceny therefrom, break and open, or open, or carry away, any pump, tank, or other similar equipment or container used for dispensing or storing kerosene, gasoline or motor oils, he shall be guilty of a Class 6 felony.
